name: MET kinase DMS benchmark
description: Benchmark of mutational-effect and ligand-affinity prediction models on deep mutational scanning of the MET kinase domain with 5,434 missense variants under DMSO and 11 kinase inhibitors.

attributes.scope_note: Scope is the MET kinase domain plus full-length context. The README also gives five other kinase DMS sets (CDK4, CDK6, EGFR, FGFR, SRC) as not split.
attributes.source_locator: description: GitHub README opening; bioRxiv preprint Abstract; task: GitHub README, Annotation columns (mean as DMS score target) and Repository layout (MET_affinity.csv as protein-ligand affinity and binding ddG); 12 conditions (DMSO plus 11 inhibitors); predictions from 57 computational methods; scope_note: GitHub README, Repository layout: kinase domain (287 aa) and full-length (1390 aa) contexts; five other kinase sets in kinases/, not split
attributes.task: Mutational-effect prediction (per-variant fitness, mean target in kinase-domain numbering, 287 aa) and affinity or ddG prediction (MET_affinity.csv) for 5,434 MET missense variants across 12 conditions (DMSO plus A458, Cabo, Camp, Crizo, Gle, Glu, Mere, NVP, Savo, Tepo, Tiv).
